summary: Transglobal Management Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of all outstanding shares of Continuum Software Technologies, Inc. (CSTI) under a Share Exchange Agreement dated March 20, 2026. As consideration, Transglobal issued 50,645,000 shares of its common stock to CSTI shareholders; no cash price per share or implied value is stated. The board recommended the transaction; no financial advisor is named. The stock was issued in reliance on Section 4(2) of the Securities Act as an unregistered sale to accredited investors. The acquisition closed immediately upon signing, with no regulatory clock or break fee disclosed. Watch for post-close integration and potential dilution from the large share issuance.
